scope: Independent full pass over all 63 ui.console keys at the current bytes: read en/ui.console.json and en/ui.console.context.json, console-states.tsx (ended banner) and console-pane.tsx (tab strip), the core glossary and locale style guides, and docs/I18N.md; checked accuracy, register, glossary consistency, placeholder/ICU integrity, CLDR plurals, ur RTL and cell widths. No catalogue, ledger or code changes.

findings.issue: " · sin plazas libres" is 20 cells against 7 in English (+186%) and is appended to the width-critical header summary, so at the narrow step the at-limit alarm is the text the truncating span drops first.

"Eliminar" is the es catalogue's term for "Delete" (ui.agents.dialogs.delete.confirm, ui.chat.dialogs.delete_action), while "Clear" is "Borrar" (ui.agents.dialogs.clear.confirm, ui.common.forms.editable_field.clear); using "Eliminar" for Clear throughout ui.console (cleanup.label, dismiss_history, dismiss.body, dismiss.title, dismiss.confirm, tab.clear_label, tab.clear_label_retained) makes the cleanup control read as deleting terminals.
findings.suggestion: Borrar terminales de agentes finalizadas, and align the family on "Borrar" for the clear action while keeping "eliminar" for deleting the retained output (e.g. "Borrar terminal y eliminar la salida conservada").
